synthesis: The source supports a staged representation change from an analytic mean square to a localized arithmetic diagonal: Mellin residues express the functional-equation integral through ratio kernels; parity-restricted character orthogonality converts the squared expansion into four-index product congruences; short support removes the negative-congruence competitors and makes the positive congruence an exact product diagonal; common-product and gcd/lcm coordinates then expose coprime factors on which the mollifier's Möbius expansion and a uniform coprime estimate act, leaving an Eulerian arithmetic main sum.
source_support: Unit u09 defines the ratio kernel R_a and its complementary residue expansions. Unit u10 applies fixed-parity character orthogonality to obtain the plus/minus congruence sums and identifies m1 n2=m2 n1 as the intended main geometry. Unit u11 uses all indices below q^(1/2) to turn the negative congruence into m1 n2=q-m2 n1 and bounds it, while also bounding the principal-character term. Unit u12 restricts to the exact-product diagonal, inserts the finite residue expansion, and controls all but the leading matched-scale contribution using common-product and gcd/lcm parameterizations. Unit u13 reparameterizes that surviving diagonal by a common product, gcd i, and coprime factors j1,j2, expands each mollifier weight into truncated logarithmic Möbius sums, and applies Lemma 9.1 to obtain the reduced arithmetic main sum (9.8).
nonparaphrase_operation: The operations depend on one another across distinct units: orthogonality can expose a modular incidence relation only after the kernel expansion supplies its interlaced ratio weights; the support cutoff then separates a rigid exact diagonal from the negative congruence; residue decay localizes that diagonal; and gcd/coprime coordinates make the surviving four-index sum compatible with Möbius expansion and the coprime estimate. No single parent contains this full analytic-to-arithmetic dependency chain.
limits: The exact parent packet ends at the Eulerian arithmetic sum (9.8); it does not contain the subsequent evaluation as an Euler product, so the candidate's terminal phrase must not be read as an established product formula. The argument retains the stated short support, squarefreeness and coprimality conditions, 1/2<=sigma<1 regimes (with a separate central interpretation), and very small |t|. OCR corruption makes exact residue signs, sine/gamma factors, normalizations, cutoff powers, exponents, and error constants unsafe without scan verification.
quality_reason: Accepted because five distinct source units jointly document a concrete succession of representation changes and obstruction controls, not merely a shared theme: contour residues feed the orthogonality decomposition, congruence rigidity isolates the exact product relation, and arithmetic reparameterization enables the Möbius/coprime reduction. Acceptance is limited to the mechanism through the Eulerian sum and expressly excludes the unsupported claim that these exact spans already evaluate the final Euler product.
